whatsappMessage:
Hi Sagar Fastfood Team,

I noticed your tandoor hut has a strong 4.6★ rating from 130+ food lovers in Mithapur, Patna, but you currently don't have a dedicated direct ordering and menu website (the link points to Swiggy).

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct zero-commission WhatsApp ordering, tandoor specials menu, aur direct Google directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/sagar

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Sagar Fastfood Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Sagar fastfood and tandoor hut) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with zero-commission WhatsApp ordering and a showcase of your top-rated tandoor menu in Mithapur, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu prices aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
